repos_data.description: Financial market primitives — price types, order book, OHLCV, indicators, position ledger, risk monitor

C++ 17 based library (with sample applications) for testing equities, futures, currencies, etfs & options based automated trading ideas using DTN IQFeed real time data feed and Interactive Brokers (IB TWS API) for trade execution. libtorch/lstm/cuda demo. Support for Alpaca & Phemex. Notifications via Telegram.
High performance, low-latency backtesting engine for testing quantitative trading strategies on historical and live data in Rust
Microstructure order-flow metrics — Order Flow Imbalance (OFI), depth and trade imbalance. Dependency-free TypeScript.
Python SDK for Polymarket order book data and backtesting. Tick-level L2 snapshots, billions of deltas, full book reconstruction, and a strategy backtesting engine with realistic execution.
A python library for computing technical analysis indicators on streaming data.
Realistic limit-order fill simulator for options credit/debit spreads. Engine-agnostic, data-source-agnostic.
Aggregate trade data into user-defined candles using information driven rules

The first end-to-end C++20 implementation of special-relativistic geometry applied to financial OHLCV data. Computes Lorentz factors, spacetime intervals, Christoffel symbols, and geodesic deviation signals from live market data.
A framework-agnostic risk-management toolkit for systematic traders: position sizing, drawdown control, stops, correlation limits, and a pre-trade validator.

Open-source AI trading signal engine with a public, inspectable outcome ledger. Our own signals lose money on average after modeled costs — we publish every row anyway. Multi-timeframe TA, backtester, paper trading, Telegram/Discord alerts. Self-hosted, Next.js + PostgreSQL, MIT.

repo_meta_data.description: Real-time market data streaming primitives — 100K+ ticks/second ingestion pipeline
